metadata.description: BeeKeeper-Kit: a per-project kit of default skills and mods (superpowers, karpathy guidelines, hive-router, agent-hud), with optional taste-skill and caveman picked by bee-scout.

plugins.name: bee-keeper
plugins.description: Per-project kit: installs the default skills and mods, and bee-scout picks optional skills from your project's plan.

plugins.name: hive-router
plugins.description: Picks each subagent's model and effort from the task, learns from runs that fall short (climbing Haiku, Sonnet, Opus, and to high effort), steps back down after a streak of successes, and reminds the main agent to delegate.

plugins.name: agent-hud
plugins.description: Context bar above the prompt plus an agents panel (/hud): the main agent and every subagent with an icon, active/idle state, context fill, tokens and estimated cost, and what the last completed task burned.

plugins.name: superpowers
plugins.description: Workflow skills: brainstorming, plans, TDD, debugging, verification.

plugins.name: andrej-karpathy-skills
plugins.description: Four coding guidelines: think first, simplicity, surgical changes, verifiable goals.

plugins.name: taste-skill
plugins.description: Frontend and web UI art direction with a browser check; needs Node 22+ and Chromium.

plugins.name: caveman
plugins.description: Opt-in terse answers to save tokens; adds SessionStart and SubagentStart hooks.
